intro: Wine Shop Advert is a brief promotional errand handed out by Renato Gallina in the Trade District of Stormwind. He entices passersby with a voucher for a complimentary bottle of vintage wine from his family's storefront along the canals. It serves as an everyday glimpse into the domestic trade and small businesses flourishing within the reconstructed capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind. And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.
Here, take this pamphlet. Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir. You won't regret it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings and welcome, friend. Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so you've seen Renato? Well here you are, friend. A bottle of our special pinot noir. You'll not find its equal in all of Azeroth!
